title: Data Architect
summary: Data architects decide how a company's data is stored, modelled, moved and governed across its warehouses, data lakes and pipelines. They sit above data engineering teams, agree data strategy with business leaders and set the standards that engineers build to.
dailyDuties: Design data models for a new business area
Review pipeline and warehouse designs from data engineers
Plan the move of a legacy warehouse to a cloud lakehouse
Set data quality, lineage and access rules with the governance team
Meet business leaders to agree reporting and AI data needs
Write architecture documents and decision records

skills.expectation: Design dimensional, data vault or lakehouse models and set modelling standards
Design a lake or lakehouse with clear layers such as bronze, silver and gold
Choose and design warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift or Synapse
Set the patterns for batch ingestion and transformation pipelines
Read and review complex SQL across the platform
Design large-scale processing on Spark or Databricks
Set up data quality checks, lineage, catalogues and ownership
Design data platforms on at least one major cloud
Design data platforms on at least one major cloud
Design data platforms on at least one major cloud
Agree data strategy and roadmaps with business and engineering leaders
Guide data engineers and review their designs
Design real-time pipelines with Kafka, Kinesis or Event Hub
Choose and standardise a scheduler such as Airflow
Prototype pipelines and checks in Python
Plan moves from on-premise warehouses to the cloud

groups.label: A cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP)

certifications.why: AWS data services such as Glue, Redshift and Kinesis
Covers data platform design on Google Cloud.
Vendor-neutral proof of data management and governance knowledge.
